Tells whether a channel is still playing. A paused channel counts as playing, and a channel that has ended or was stopped does not.

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
While ChannelPlaying(ch) And Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Playing..."
	Flip
Wend
Cls
Text 10, 10, "Finished"
Flip
Delay 500
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound) or [PlayMusic](PlayMusic).
@returns 1 if the channel is playing or paused, otherwise 0.
@gap A handle of 0, which the play commands give when there is no sound device or the sound failed to load, is never playing.
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out. A channel that is over is fine everywhere, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
